title: Fabric Dirt Slabs
description: This mod adds craftable dirt slabs!
body:
![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1cf0d7149e4958ef5671240f207d07a80b90f2af.png)

This wonderful, amazing, unbeliveable mod adds one simple but surprisingly useful feature to Minecraft: Dirt Slabs, crafted entirely from dirt 🙂
By placing three dirt blocks in a horizontal row, you can craft dirt slabs just like you would with wooden or stone slabs 😄
These slabs are perfect for builders who want more control over terrain details without breaking the vanilla survival feel 😉
Dirt slabs allow you to create smoother hills, cleaner paths, and more natural-looking landscapes with half-block precision 🙂
They fit seamlessly into farms, caves, villages, and underground builds where full dirt blocks feel too bulky 😄
Because the recipe uses only dirt, this mod stays extremely balanced and accessible from the very start of the game 😉
There are no extra mechanics, machines, or complicated systems to learn, keeping the mod lightweight and beginner-friendly 🙂
The slabs behave exactly how you expect, snapping cleanly into builds and blending naturally with existing dirt blocks 😄
This makes the mod ideal for vanilla-plus modpacks or players who just want a tiny quality-of-life improvement 😉
If you love simple additions that feel like they should have always existed in Minecraft, this mod is made for you 🙂
Install it, craft some slabs, and enjoy building with dirt in a whole new way 😄

![Slabs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8acaf20db5806b3af588e560139c70ca79f298fc.png)
